scope: Read-only source/cache-schema and experiment review; no remote cache bytes, new model code, GPU work or probe execution
question: Does the frozen soft GAViT feedback depend on cross-region GAT messages, beyond the per-region learned transforms?
novelty_relative_to_completed_probes: Alpha=0 removes all feedback including local transformations; self-loop-only retains frozen learned transforms but removes cross-region GAT edges.

cached_scope.full_1260_pooling: pooled/logits/classifier, no region nodes or edges
cached_scope.selected_90_pooling: normal and membership_only S/W/regions/edges/pooled/logits; only normal is proposed for new question

proposed_probe.mode: CPU only, eval, no gradient, two predeclared conditions: original edges and self-loops only
proposed_probe.samples: existing fixed 90 val cases, no new selection
proposed_probe.control: independent mean_tokens from earlier feedback cache; replay original graph against stored pooled and logits before any interpretation
proposed_probe.held_fixed: regions, S, all parameters, feedback/readout formulas; classifier eval
proposed_probe.avoid: Do not reconstruct mean_tokens solely by subtracting the same replayed feedback from pooled: would make part of the check circular
proposed_probe.end_condition: one exploratory case probe only; no automatic full-val capture, edge sweep or training; missing/corrupt caches or mismatch stops

interpretation_limits: Selected 90 cases do not provide population metrics or stable improvement
Self-only is inference intervention in a jointly trained model, not a trained no-graph baseline
Neighbor deletion changes attention normalization and is not parameter-neutral evidence of message harm alone
Backbone/soft pooling already mix information; self-only only removes GAT cross-region communication

other_options_considered.change_assignment_temperature_radius_or_: No new evidence to justify another sweep of closed candidate
other_options_considered.move_graph_to_earlier_Swin_stage_or_chan: Potential architecture question, changes multiple dimensions and needs controlled design; not immediate paid trial
